'''Karastace Gonn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[General/Legends|General]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
During the [[Great Galactic War]], Karastace Gonn had been a thorn in the Empire's side, preventing Imperial forces from being able to conquer fringe systems.<ref name="Set the Table" />

{{GameDS}}
Early during the [[Galactic War]], Karastace had been gathering Imperials within the ranks of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] to defect to the Republic at a secret hideout on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. Karastace was successful, but [[Darth Baras]] had learned that Gonn was to meet with a some of these traitors on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]]. He sent [[Empire's Wrath|his apprentice]] to [[Assassination of Karastace Gonn|eliminate]] Gonn and Imperial mole [[Fawste]]. Gonn and his troops fought against the [[Sith Warrior]] and were all [[Death/Legends|killed]].<ref name="Set the Table" />
{{Endgame}}
